text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is reporting on the results of the traffic calming poll undertaken on College View Avenue, between Avenue Road and Oriole Parkway. The poll provided a response rate of less than the 50 percent plus one ballot required by the Traffic Calming Policy needed to confirm that there is a favourable consensus in the community to install speed humps on the subject section of College View Avenue. Accordingly, continuing the process to install speed humps on College View Avenue, between Avenue Road and Oriole Parkway, is not recommended.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on College View Avenue, between Avenue Road and Oriole Parkway.
